snippet.title: Play Your Cards | Kirugakuen DEMO Teaser
snippet.description:
♥ ♠ ♦ ♣ JOIN THE KIRUGAKUEN DISCORD SERVER: https://discord.gg/M7Cf6GKc9P 

Play your cards well. — This is a short gameplay teaser for the upcoming demo of Kirugakuen, recorded straight from the game. Get prepared, the Black Suit Man will meet you soon...

Join the new 🃏 DISCORD SERVER 🃏 here: https://discord.gg/M7Cf6GKc9P

♥️♠️♦️♣️

Kirugakuen is a new and fresh killing game concept surrounded by horror, poker and showtime themes. Unveil all the mysteries of The Academy, and most importantly, win!

Follow development on X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/kirugakuen
